name: Elektra
description: Mexican retailer with an online store on VTEX selling appliances, phones, computers, mattresses, furniture, motorcycles and more. Its homepage has a postal-code field and a store finder but does not state a delivery coverage area.
description_es: Tienda mexicana con tienda en línea sobre VTEX que vende línea blanca, telefonía, cómputo, colchones, muebles, motos y más. Su página principal tiene un campo de código postal y un buscador de tiendas, pero no indica zona de cobertura de entrega.

ships_to.notes: Homepage has a postal-code field; no coverage area named on the pages read.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Store finder exists; pickup of online orders is not stated on the pages read.
